import importlib.util, pickle

D=m._Design(past,hold,dt,times,x)
products=np.column_stack([x[:,i]*x[:,j] for i in range(4) for j in range(i+1,4)]+[x[:,0]*x[:,1]*x[:,2]])

            pred=b[val]@result.x
        r=Y[val]-pred
        err[name].append([np.median(np.abs(r[:,:-1])),np.median(np.abs(r[:,-1]))])
